cards.title: Execute the North-to-South Transition
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Beach Line Departures/High Bridge
instructions: Fly over the Intracoastal Waterway at 4,500' MSL · 240 KIAS
Passing abeam the High Bridge, descend to 2,500' MSL and maintain 240 KIAS
cards.detail: The binder limits this transition to the northern working areas (Mustang 1/2 and Fox 1/2); the PPT says North/Central Mustang. Check with an instructor before using it from Mustang 5/6.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 24, 48; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 92; Part 2, slides 52, 54.
